build_aes_multi_output_model: build an AesMultiOutput model with WavLM encoder and MLP projection heads for audio aesthetics prediction
run_aes_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the AesMultiOutput model with a batch dict containing wav and mask tensors
create_normalize_transform: create a Normalize dataclass with mean and std to transform and inverse transform audio features
review_aes_weighted_layer_sum: review the AesMultiOutput forward method and its weighted layer sum mechanism for multi-axis audio prediction
test_aes_freeze_encoder: test the AesMultiOutput model with freeze_encoder set to true to prevent WavLM weight updates during training
